data.name: Bazish
data.gender_notes: Bazish is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'B-Z-SH' meaning 'to be strong, powerful or to strike'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the context of Prophet Moses and his brother Harun (Aaron) who were given divine authority and were called upon to lead their people towards righteousness. The name Bazish carries the meaning “Strong, powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bazish usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength in faith and resilience in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Bazish belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bazish total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_pashto.name: بازيش
in_pashto.meaning: بازيش نوم د خوښۍ، خوشحالۍ، او جشن معنی لري
